messages:
Mina: Hey all — I just uploaded the Optimize launch post draft. Need a quickpass on: hero line (short), the single benchmark sentence, CTA copy, and a publish slot. Doc: https://go/redwood/optimize-q2-draft :wave:

Cal: Reading now. Bench nit: current text 'saves 40% on tokens' -> recommend 'cuts effective token spend by ~40%' to be precise.

Jordan: For hero quote, draft from CEO: 

`"Optimize helps teams serve high-capacity models at a lower unit cost."`

Can tighten for social if needed.

Cal: Slight tweak for hero card: `"Serve high-capacity models at lower unit cost with Optimize."` shorter and punchy. :+1:

Jordan: Ok with that. Legal, any flags on bench claim or quote? @LegalBot

LegalBot: Quickpass complete — bench phrasing ok with 'effective' hedge. Recommend avoiding absolutes like 'always' or 'guaranteed'. Quote fine as-is.

Mina: Growth asked for UTMs to route webinar signups and tracking: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q2&utm_medium=organic` Also want a webinar CTA variant.

PublishBot: Tentative publish scheduled for 2026-05-05T10:00:00-07:00. Added assets: hero quote, benchmark snippet, product CTA + webinar CTA with UTMs. Smoke test reminder set for T-30m. :robot_face:

OpsBot: I'll validate HubSpot embed and run the T-30m smoke check (copy + embeds).

Cal: I'll build social cards and a short thread for X and LinkedIn.

Mina: Thanks team — locking the slot unless anyone objects by EOD. Ping here for last-minute changes. :rocket:
